title: Divisible Digit Sums
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: q. Each line: N. Print one integer per
line: the count of x in [1, N] with digit sum divisible by 3.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ q ≤ 1000; 1 ≤ N ≤ 10^18.

Free-table digit DP: one 3-state transition table covers every query.

tests.name: single digits
tests.hint: 3, 6, 9 have digit sum divisible by 3: answer 3.

tests.name: up to 30
up to 100
max boundary 10^18
tests.hint: 10^18 itself has digit sum 1, so the count equals that of 10^18 - 1: exactly one third.

tests.name: all-nines boundary
tests.hint: 18 nines: digit sum 162, divisible by 3 — the closed count is N/3 = 3.33...e17.
